# Visiting Medics

> Healthcare-at-home service in Mumbai, available 24 hours. Doctor home visits, home nursing, blood tests at home, IV injection, wound dressing, catheter and Ryle's tube care, elderly and bedridden patient care. Serving Mumbai from Colaba and Churchgate to Borivali and Dahisar.

Phone / WhatsApp: +91 80808 82201
Website: https://visitingmedics.com
